scope: Every IB Chemistry 2016-2019 row (HL and SL) with candidate secondary subtopics: the 2016-2019 extension reconciled results (source 85cae43c, receipt-pinned SHA-256 af5d0a79...) and the 2019 HL Paper 2 review manifest.
method: Four independent text-only reviewers, one per batch of about 173 rows, judged every candidate link against the official mark scheme. A link is kept only if a printed part earns at least 1 mark for knowledge in that subtopic beyond the primary; context, keyword matches, primary-subtopic content and doubtful cases are dropped. No link was added. Borderline calls (for example R1 half-equations inside fuel-cell parts) may differ between batches; doubt resolves to drop.
